articles.summary: Plug Power spent May 8-10, 2018 at the UTC Technology & Telecom conference and tradeshow in Palm Springs, CA. Darin Painter, our executive sales director for stationary power, spoke to attendees about how trends in LTE networks and backup power are meshing to morph best practices in utility telecom power.
articles.title: How Evolutions in LTE networks and Fuel Cell Power Have Changed the Site Paradigm for Utility Telecom
